blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — After nearly two decades of waiting for formal recognition of their ancestral land, the Hanunuo Mangyan indigenous community in Mindoro has finally secured approval of its application for a Certificate of Recognition of Ancestral Domain (CRAD). The National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP) on Wednesday announced that the approved application covers 41,508.95674 hectares, comprising 38,389.95674 hectares of ancestral land and 3,119 hectares of ancestral waters. The territory spans the municipalities of Bulalacao, Mansalay and Roxas in Oriental Mindoro, and Barangay Naibuan in San Jose, Occidental Mindoro.
